missing_values: Blank means unknown/unfilled unless explicitly documented as not applicable; never replace unknown with zero or False.

descriptions.case_id: Stable unique episode ID. Preserve this ID when correcting a row.
descriptions.event_date_ist: Incident date in India time when established, normally YYYY-MM-DD; preserve qualified dates or ranges. Blank is unknown, not zero.
descriptions.date_basis: How the incident date was established; explain alternatives or conflicts. Article publication date is not automatically the incident date.
descriptions.state: State or union territory relevant to the episode; explain cross-border force jurisdiction separately.
descriptions.case_name: Short public description/person or case identifier as reported, without unnecessary personal identifiers.
descriptions.practice: Reported practice, e.g. firearm-taking followed by police shooting, parade, or contextual exclusion. Existing seed labels are retained.
descriptions.context: Ordinary crime, custody, crowd, insurgency, border operation, jail, or other setting, with qualifications.
descriptions.comparison_class: How closely this episode matches the research outcome; keep near matches and exclusions explicit.
descriptions.gun_taking_scope: Who allegedly took whose firearm; individual versus group attribution. Unknown does not mean no.
descriptions.gun_taking_stage: Attempted or completed taking as alleged, or not stated/not applicable.
descriptions.reported_outcome: Who was reportedly shot, fatal/nonfatal outcome, and relevant qualifications.
descriptions.clothing: Clothing/stripping as reported; distinguish unknown from not applicable.
descriptions.reconstruction: Whether crime-scene reconstruction is expressly established; preserve qualifications.
descriptions.source_article_ids: TOI article IDs, separated by semicolons where several; blank for sources without TOI IDs.
descriptions.source_publication_dates: Source publication metadata as recorded. Legacy timezone strings may be retained; do not substitute for event dates.
descriptions.source_urls: One or more supporting article/document URLs, separated by semicolons. Required.
descriptions.evidence_notes: Brief attributed source interpretation and relevant passages or paraphrases. For verified old-file linkage, identify file/hash and row or exact date-headline.
descriptions.uncertainties: Disputes, missing bodies, conflicting dates, possible duplicates, source limitations and unknown values.
descriptions.review_status: Original detailed source-review assessment; distinct from the standardized community record_status.
descriptions.input_table: Original review ledger or input file. Seed values are preserved; a contributor can use their issue/PR as provenance.
descriptions.chief_minister: Chief minister at the incident date, or blank if unknown. Do not backdate later appointments.
descriptions.cm_party_at_incident: Contemporary party affiliation. Do not backdate later party switches or renamed parties.
descriptions.government_at_incident: Governing party or coalition at the incident date, with coalition qualifications.
descriptions.government_date_display: Date, interval or alternatives used to assign the government; preserve uncertainty.
descriptions.government_date_basis: Evidence and reasoning for the date used for the government assignment.
descriptions.bjp_led_state_government: True, False, unknown or blank. BJP coalition participation is separate. Unknown is not False.
descriptions.bjp_participation_note: Distinguish BJP leadership, cabinet/coalition participation and other affiliations.
descriptions.government_sources: Dated government/party evidence URLs, separated by semicolons. Required whenever a government assignment is made.
descriptions.government_confidence: Qualified assessment of the government assignment, not confidence that the police account is true.
descriptions.reported_force: Reported police, prison, central-force or other institution.
descriptions.institutional_authority: Institutional authority over that force; distinguish state, Union and election supervision where relevant.
descriptions.authority_note: Authority qualifications; incumbency does not establish instructions or responsibility for a particular act.
descriptions.authority_sources: Supporting authority URLs, separated by semicolons.
descriptions.union_government_when_central: Contemporary Union government when relevant to a central force or Delhi Police.
descriptions.government_input: Source government audit file or contributor provenance.
descriptions.record_status: pending_review, ai_reviewed, human_reviewed, or needs_recheck. These are process statuses, not findings of factual truth.
descriptions.reviewed_by: Named reviewer or AI tool for reviewed rows. Do not invent a human reviewer.
descriptions.contribution_url: GitHub issue/PR documenting the submission or review; seed rows link to the frozen source snapshot.
descriptions.record_updated_date: Date this record was last revised, YYYY-MM-DD.
descriptions.discovery_basis: Recorded discovery/review stream, e.g. web_source_review_ledger, cached_article_body_review_ledger, contributor_submission, or another explained route. It is not necessarily the sole discovery route.
descriptions.headline_file_linkage: not_row_level_verified for seed rows. Use verified only with an explicit original headline-file hash/row or exact date-headline match in evidence_notes; use not_applicable for sources without such linkage.
